description: This Java class 'ConnectionOptions' defines configuration options for managing HTTP connection behaviors, such as headers, chunking, keep-alive, and socket closing delays within the mockserver framework.

classes.name: ConnectionOptions
classes.description: A class providing configurable options for HTTP connection handling, including headers, chunking, keep-alive, and socket closing behaviors.

methods.name: connectionOptions
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of ConnectionOptions.

methods.name: withSuppressContentLengthHeader
methods.description: Sets whether to suppress the 'Content-Length' header in responses.

methods.name: getSuppressContentLengthHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the current setting for suppressing the 'Content-Length' header.

methods.name: withContentLengthHeaderOverride
methods.description: Overrides the 'Content-Length' header with a specific value.

methods.name: withSuppressConnectionHeader
methods.description: Sets whether to suppress the 'Connection' header.

methods.name: getSuppressConnectionHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the current setting for suppressing the 'Connection' header.

methods.name: withChunkSize
methods.description: Sets the size of chunks for chunked responses.

methods.name: withKeepAliveOverride
methods.description: Overrides the 'Connection' header to specify keep-alive behavior.

methods.name: getKeepAliveOverride
methods.description: Retrieves the current keep-alive override setting.

methods.name: withCloseSocket
methods.description: Sets whether to close the socket after response.

methods.name: getCloseSocket
methods.description: Retrieves the current socket close setting.

methods.name: getCloseSocketDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the delay before closing socket.
